requires.hint: u-blox PHY calibration patches exist for ESP-IDF 5.1, 5.5 and 6.2 only. For any other IDF, add a re-cut patch to esp-idf/nora-w40/patches/ and a matching sdk_version op here.

sdk_patch.note: u-blox PHY calibration component, installed SDK-wide so any example picks it up

sdk_patch.warning: ESP-IDF 5.5 patch: same PHY init data layout as 5.1, but the TX power values were characterised on 5.1. Confirm with the u-blox RF team before shipping.
ESP-IDF 6.2 patch: same PHY init data layout as 5.1, but the TX power values were characterised on 5.1. Confirm with the u-blox RF team before shipping.

notes: The country code selects the channel set and the certified power table; it is not a substitute for the PHY calibration patch.

mac.source: ESP32-C6 eFuse, programmed in u-blox production
notes: Four addresses are derived from the base MAC: Wi-Fi STA, Wi-Fi AP, Bluetooth, Ethernet.

verify.log_contains: ubx_phy_cal: loading PHY init data from application binary
notes: If that line is absent the application is running on the Espressif default PHY data and is not regulatory compliant.
